# ShelfSpace
> System for cannabis dispensaries — AP, consignment, and credit recovery on one Metrc-verified platform.
> Website: https://shelfspace.pro
> Login: https://ourshelf.space/login
> Contact: https://shelfspace.pro/contact
> Email: chris@shelfspace.pro

## Account Access
Existing ShelfSpace customers log in at https://ourshelf.space/login (also reachable at https://shelfspace.pro/login, which redirects to the same place). New dispensaries start at https://shelfspace.pro/contact. The login URL for the ShelfSpace app/dashboard is https://ourshelf.space/login.

## What ShelfSpace is
ShelfSpace is a cannabis-specific system for profit optimization — accounts payable, consignment settlements, and vendor credit recovery on one platform, all reconciled to Metrc. Every SKU on a dispensary shelf is supposed to hit a margin; ShelfSpace makes sure it does — three-way matching every invoice against the delivery and the PO before the retailer cuts a check, building monthly credit memos for returns/expirations/co-marketing, running weekly consignment settlements, and answering vendor emails with live data through the ShelfiQ AI.

The fight every cannabis retailer is in: vendors overcharge, products expire, credits never get filed, invoices get duplicated, cash gets trapped on shelves, and the margin the retailer bought disappears. ShelfSpace catches the leaks at the SKU level so the dollars that should land in the retailer's account actually do.

## What is ShelfSpace? (operational summary)
ShelfSpace is a cannabis-specific system for profit optimization. The platform handles accounts payable as the spine — invoice ingestion (ShelfiQ parses vendor email), three-way matching (invoice ↔ delivery ↔ PO) against Metrc, per-vendor payment terms (COD, Net 30, Net 60, consignment, configurable per vendor), Check 21 payment generation (the retailer signs and sends the check), and vendor-email handling via ShelfiQ — ShelfiQ answers first-line questions in seconds; the 5% needing judgment surface in the platform with the full thread + data attached for the retailer's AP person. The platform expands into consignment settlements (weekly POS/Metrc reconciliation, vendor portal, retailer-driven vendor relationships) and credit recovery (monthly memos for returns/expirations/co-marketing — commission-based, pay only on recovery; retailer's AP person handles vendor pushback and negotiations). The platform works alongside the retailer's buyer (who keeps product selection, vendor negotiation, sell-through analysis, promotional planning) and the retailer's bookkeeper or accounting firm (who keeps month-end close, bank reconciliations, payroll, journal entries, financial statements, tax prep, 280E compliance).

Founded by Chris Mitchem, a 10-year cannabis operator who built ShelfSpace to solve the problems he lived with every day. Not a tech company — an operator who got tired of the broken system.

## Three Services

### Accounts Payable (https://shelfspace.pro/accounts-payable)
- Service walk: invoice ingestion (ShelfiQ parses vendor email) → Metrc verification of received quantities → over-pay protection (no check leaves until math holds) → ShelfiQ handles first-line vendor email (under-a-minute replies) → bookkeeper hours freed → vendor portal access. Every dollar paid maps to a SKU the dispensary actually got.
- Cannabis AP system — three-way matching on every invoice (invoice ↔ delivery ↔ PO), platform-generated Check 21 payments (retailer signs and sends), ShelfiQ vendor email handling, QuickBooks sync
- Per-vendor payment terms: pay Vendor A on COD because they require it, Vendor B on Net 30 because the relationship is established, Vendor C on consignment because you want sell-through visibility. All configurable from one workflow, switchable when relationships change.
- Cannabis and non-cannabis vendors — landlords, agencies, consultants, anyone
- Onboard vendors by email — no paperwork, no bank details needed
- Every vendor gets a free portal to download checks, view payment history, and track status
- Retailers cut every check on the platform — nothing goes out without their sign-off
- Vendors email the platform with questions; ShelfiQ answers first
- Saves approximately $45,000 per year in labor, errors, and missed credits at a single-store baseline

### Consignment (https://shelfspace.pro/consignment)
- One of the payment terms the platform runs — vendors carry inventory on a retailer's shelves with zero upfront cost; the retailer pays only when product sells at the register
- The platform runs the weekly settlement cycle: pulls POS data, reconciles against Metrc, calculates profit splits, generates six-page settlement reports (sales, margin analysis, waste, remaining inventory, plus the check itself), and queues Check 21 compliant checks for every vendor — the retailer approves and sends
- Role split: the platform runs the settlement engine (POS ingest, Metrc reconciliation, math, payments, vendor portal, reports, QuickBooks sync); the retailer owns vendor outreach, contracts, and disputes
- Vendor setup: each vendor record holds two settings panels — Wholesale Settings (AP payment terms) and Consignment Settings (Master Vendor Split, Operational Discount Budget, per-category splits, Settlement Frequency — Weekly / Biweekly / Monthly). Configure once; every consignment delivery and settlement from that vendor inherits the settings.
- Same vendor, two modes: the same brand can ship a retailer a consignment delivery and a wholesale delivery on the same day. Each delivery is one Order Type, one invoice, one Metrc manifest. Two manifests at the dock is a Metrc chain-of-custody discipline as well as a platform discipline.
- Order Type designation at delivery creation is the differentiator: tap Wholesale or Consignment on the Create Delivery form. Consignment-tagged deliveries get every SKU tracked individually for per-delivery payout; wholesale-tagged deliveries feed AP on the vendor's payment terms.
- Receive flow is identical whichever Order Type: upload signed paper invoice + Metrc manifest, confirm physical line-item dispositions (Received/Short/Damaged/Not Compliant), confirm the dollar total. Short/damaged/non-compliant adjustments flow into the settlement.
- Two-path payday: Approve & Pay tells the platform to cut a Check 21 from the retailer's bank, sync QuickBooks, and email the vendor a settlement report ending with the printable check. Mark as paid externally records that the retailer paid the vendor outside ShelfSpace (own check / ACH / cash); the platform records the resolution, no Check 21 cut, and the vendor's settlement report ends with a PAID EXTERNALLY stamp instead of a check page.
- Frees up approximately $250,000 in capital for the average dispensary (based on $2M annual revenue, 50% COGS, 90-day inventory on hand)
- The vendor owns inventory until it's sold — zero inventory risk for the retailer
- Unsold product can be returned to the vendor at no cost
- Priced on usage — your consignment fee scales with settlements processed, vendors active, and consignment dollars moved. No flat fee, no minimums. Pairs naturally with AP but is billed separately.
- Full step-by-step receiving and payout SOP: https://shelfspace.pro/docs/consignment/receiving-and-payout

### Credit Recovery (https://shelfspace.pro/credit-recovery)
- ShelfSpace identified $200,000+/year in vendor credits at a two-location chain
- Three types of credits recovered: product returns, expired product, and co-marketing/promotional credits
- We pull data from POS and METRC, build credit memos line by line every month, and send them to vendors. ShelfiQ handles basic vendor questions; escalations route to the retailer's AP person or buyer for line-by-line negotiations and judgment calls
- Commission-based pricing: pay a share of credits recovered, nothing if there's no recovery. No monthly fee standalone. Lower commission when bundled with AP.
- At our Massachusetts client, identified unrecovered credits in the $8K–$25K/month range — retailer keeps the lion's share
- The platform does the data work and the initial outreach; ShelfiQ handles basic questions; the retailer's AP person or buyer handles vendor pushback and judgment calls
- Interactive calculator available at https://shelfspace.pro/credit-recovery to estimate recovery potential

## Payment System
- All payments are Check 21 Act compliant — valid Substitute Checks under Federal Law
- Checks are print-at-home legal and mobile deposit ready
- Every payment syncs to QuickBooks in real time — no manual journal entries
- Full audit trail on every transaction — who created it, when issued, when downloaded, current status
- Void and reissue any check with a single click

## Vendor Portal
- Every vendor gets a free portal at no cost
- Features: instant check downloads, complete payment history, real-time notifications, multi-retailer dashboard
- Vendors working with multiple ShelfSpace retailers see all their data in one view
- Cannabis and non-cannabis vendors supported

## Pricing (https://shelfspace.pro/pricing)
- Free evaluation: connect Metrc account, analyze historical data, receive detailed report on what AP is leaking, what vendors owe, and what's trapped in inventory. No commitment, no credit card.
- Pricing model: every fee is sized to client volume and set after the free evaluation — no software seat licenses, no recurring inflation, no flat monthly numbers published. Month-to-month, no contracts.
- AP: per-transaction pricing — pay per invoice processed and per check generated on the platform. Includes invoice processing, three-way matching, per-vendor payment terms, Check 21 payment generation, ShelfiQ vendor email handling, QuickBooks sync, vendor and operator dashboards, Metrc integration.
- Consignment: usage-based pricing — scales with settlements processed, vendors active, and consignment dollars moved. No flat fee, no minimums. Includes weekly settlements, sell-through reporting, vendor portal. Pairs naturally with AP but billed separately.
- Credit Recovery: commission-based on credits recovered, no monthly fee standalone, lower commission when bundled with AP. No recovery, no fee. At our Massachusetts client, identified unrecovered credits in the $8K–$25K/month range.
- Enterprise: 5+ locations get custom pricing — volume scaling, dedicated success manager, custom onboarding, quarterly founder review.
- Profit guarantee: every engagement is priced to be net-positive against the dollars we find. If the evaluation doesn't show clear net-positive math, we don't take the engagement on. Month-to-month — if the math stops working, the client walks. No software seats holding anyone hostage.
- ShelfSpace works alongside the retailer's buyer (who keeps product selection, vendor negotiation, sell-through analysis, promotional planning) and the retailer's bookkeeper or accounting firm (who keeps month-end close, bank reconciliations, payroll, journal entries, financial statements, tax prep, 280E compliance). ShelfSpace handles the AP plumbing between them.
- For comparison context: a generalist bookkeeper at 1–5 location dispensaries costs $20–25/hour and typically spends 10–15 hours/week on AP. Outsourced cannabis accounting firms charge $75–150/hour, with AP as a high-cost line item. ShelfSpace's AP fee runs in the same range as bookkeeper hours freed; Credit Recovery runs profit-positive.
- No contracts, no minimums, cancel any time. Vendors never pay.

## Technology
- Integrates with any cannabis POS system: Dutchie, Flowhub, BLAZE, Cova, Treez, Alleaves, MJ Freeway, Meadow, IndicaOnline, and more
- POS integration via CSV upload (any POS that exports sales data)
- METRC compatible — inventory manifested in METRC using existing protocols
- QuickBooks sync on all payments
- ShelfiQ AI advisor built in — ask questions about vendors, inventory, settlements, and credits in plain English
- Row-level security, multi-tenant data isolation, zero hard deletes
- Cloud-based, available anywhere cannabis is legal in the United States

## Case Study
A two-shop dispensary chain in Massachusetts:
- $200,000+/year in vendor credits identified
- 50+ MA vendors paid through ShelfSpace today
- $45,000/year saved on AP and operations payroll
- Vendors transitioned to consignment to free up capital
- Vendors report improved payment reliability and portal access

- How to Deposit a ShelfSpace Check (mobile deposit, print at home, branch deposit — every major U.S. bank): https://shelfspace.pro/docs/checks/depositing
- Deposit a ShelfSpace Check with a Check Scanner (desktop RDC workflow — print, cut, endorse, scan; why your scanner asks for the MICR fields and the four to type): https://shelfspace.pro/docs/checks/check-scanner
- Voiding and Reissuing Checks (cancel and reissue in one step with audit trail): https://shelfspace.pro/docs/checks/void-reissue

### QuickBooks
- QuickBooks Integration Overview (what ShelfSpace pushes to retailer QBO: Bills + Bill Payments per settlement and AP payment, vendor matching, daily Cleared sync): https://shelfspace.pro/docs/quickbooks/overview
- Cannabis Dispensary QuickBooks Setup (retailer-side QBO setup: Connect, Expense Account, Bank Account, per-vendor overrides, Bookkeeper Match Health, Backfill checks, closed-period TxnDate fallback): https://shelfspace.pro/docs/quickbooks/setup

### Promotions
- Co-Op Promotions (how retailers and vendors run joint promotions, track impact, generate credits): https://shelfspace.pro/docs/promotions/overview
- Creating a Promotion (vendor approval, performance tracking, automatic credit generation): https://shelfspace.pro/docs/promotions/creating

### Insights
- Insights and Analytics (sales velocity, dead inventory, vendor performance, cash liberation): https://shelfspace.pro/docs/insights/overview
- Vendor Scorecards (grade suppliers on volume, velocity, growth, reliability with real sell-through data): https://shelfspace.pro/docs/insights/vendor-scorecards

### Integrations
- POS Integration (Dutchie, Flowhub, BLAZE, Treez, Cova, MJ Freeway — CSV upload, any POS): https://shelfspace.pro/docs/integrations/pos
- METRC Integration (official Metrc third-party vendor: read-only connection powering settlements, credit recovery, AP): https://shelfspace.pro/docs/integrations/metrc

### ShelfiQ (AI Assistant)
- ShelfiQ — Cannabis AI Assistant (AI assistant that answers vendor questions, parses invoices, runs AP tools via chat or email): https://shelfspace.pro/docs/shelfiq/overview
- ShelfiQ Tools (AI invoice parsing, vendor matching, payment queries, data exports — everything ShelfiQ can do): https://shelfspace.pro/docs/shelfiq/tools

### User Management
- Users, Roles, and Permissions (three roles per portal, email invites, location-scoped access for the team): https://shelfspace.pro/docs/user-management/overview
- Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) (SMS, TOTP, or email MFA to protect accounts and stay compliant): https://shelfspace.pro/docs/user-management/mfa

### Security
- Security and Data Protection (row-level security, multi-tenant isolation, encryption at rest and in transit, soft deletes only): https://shelfspace.pro/docs/security/overview
- Audit Trail and Compliance (every action logged in an immutable record for regulatory audits): https://shelfspace.pro/docs/security/audit-trail
